summary: Coherence rules over a theme object (docs/planning/theme-schema.md, step 3): combinations of parameters, colors and fonts that break the design even when every value is in range. Each rule names its concept, a severity (warning: it works but loses something, such as contrast or target size; info: a deliberate choice worth confirming). The lint advises: it never blocks a setting, a save or a build, what it checks, a fix, and a failing and a passing fixture (theme sections merged over the defaults). lintTheme (tokens/themes/lint.ts) implements one predicate per id; a test runs every fixture.

scale.target-size.checks: The control height at the theme root, (6 + 2I) × u, is at least 24px (WCAG 2.5.8 target size).
scale.target-size.fix: Raise unit, or use a looser density; keep small units for subtrees (size) instead of the root.

density.compact-border.checks: At compact density the 0.5u control inset can hold the border twice (a composite's edge and its option's), B ≤ 0.25u; otherwise one-row composites grow past the control height.
density.compact-border.fix: Use border 0 or 1 at compact density, or a larger unit.

elevation.surfaces-visible.checks: Panels and cards separate from the page: surface-contrast > 0, or cards are raised with a shadow.
elevation.surfaces-visible.fix: Raise surface-contrast, or turn on card-raised with a raised shadow.

elevation.floating-visible.checks: Floating surfaces (menus, popovers, select popups, toasts) separate from the page: a floating elevation above 0dp, or a border.
elevation.floating-visible.fix: Give shadow-floating an elevation (8dp by default), or set a border.

elevation.modal-shadow.checks: Modal surfaces cast a shadow (shadow-modal > 0dp); with none, only the backdrop separates a dialog from the page.
elevation.modal-shadow.fix: Confirm it is intended, or give shadow-modal an elevation (24dp by default).

movement.reveal-bounce.checks: The reveal intent (popups, dialogs, drawers opening) does not overshoot: it does not run the bouncy spring while it bounces.
movement.reveal-bounce.fix: Point intent-reveal at smooth or snappy, or set motion-bounce 0.

movement.feedback-fast.checks: Hover and press feedback settles within 0.3s (the feedback intent's spring duration × motion-scale).
movement.feedback-fast.fix: Point intent-feedback at a quick spring, shorten that spring, or lower motion-scale.

curvature.pill-containers.checks: Cards are not near pills: with radius-scale ≥ 2 the concentric card radius approaches half a short card's height unless radius-card lowers it.
curvature.pill-containers.fix: Confirm it is intended, or lower radius-card (for example 0.5).

vibrancy.text-contrast.checks: Each brand and feedback role's text step (11) reaches the engine's APCA threshold on the page fill, in light and dark.
vibrancy.text-contrast.fix: Raise the step 11 target (the Contrast group: Lc 60 or more), undo the tone settings the finding names, or choose another family for the role.

emphasis.on-solid.checks: Text on the primary and critical solids (step 9: filled buttons, danger actions) reaches APCA Lc 60, the level for UI text, in light and dark.
emphasis.on-solid.fix: Set a manual peak tone where step 9 carries text at Lc 60 (the default, 62, does with the default hues), or pick a darker or lighter family for the role.

vibrancy.anchor-order.checks: An anchored step's Lc against the light page stays strictly between its neighbor steps' targets, so the ramp keeps its contrast order.
vibrancy.anchor-order.fix: Drop the anchor's step so it lands at its nearest step, or adjust the anchor's lightness.

vibrancy.anchor-range.checks: An anchor's Lc against the light page lies within the ramp (step 2's target / 2 to step 12's target + 10).
vibrancy.anchor-range.fix: Map a near-black or near-white brand ink to the black or white endpoint instead, or anchor a lighter or darker variant.
